title: License board runtime node records (0x34) and license state — memory-only

container.notes: MEMORY-ONLY (runtime). Built when the License menu shows a board; derived from the board grid file (licd, battlepack section 70 / board_N.bin), battlepack section 12 and the character keep (+0x194 owned bits, +0x1C3..+0x1C5 jobs). Lost on any screen change. Steam 1.0.4.0 addresses.

records.name: licenseBoardNode
records.where: One record per square of the board currently shown in the License menu. The Toolkit resolves the array from the MRP/menu section list at [0x0209AC60] ("[0209AC60]-derived"); the exact path is not in our write-up.
records.count: one per board square (board width x height, see battlepack-s70-license-board)

fields.name: nameTextPointer
fields.notes: Pointer to the license name text shown for this square. [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: identifier
fields.notes: License node id placed on this square (battlepack section 12 row, BpLicenseList). Width assumed 16-bit (next named field is at +0x0B). [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: unknown0A
fields.notes: Not identified by any source; keep the original bytes.

fields.name: restriction
fields.notes: Restriction class of the node (copied from section 12 +0x06). [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: cost
fields.notes: LP cost displayed/charged (section 12 +0x04 is the file value). [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: licenseIconLink
fields.notes: Link into the license icon atlas (License Node Icon table at [0x02CA9670]: 2 groups Available/Obtained x 4 entries). [src: TK L1263-L1285; TK L1157]

fields.name: typeTextPointer
fields.notes: Pointer to the license type text (32-bit; the flags start 4 bytes later). [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: Flags folder (bits not named in our write-up). [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: unknown18
fields.notes: Not identified by any source; keep the original bytes.

fields.name: column
fields.notes: Board column of the square. Editing column/row physically moves the square on screen. [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: row
fields.notes: Board row of the square. [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: animationType
fields.notes: Animation type (0-4). [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: unknown23
fields.notes: Not identified by any source; keep the original bytes.

fields.name: alpha
fields.notes: Alpha. [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: unknown26
fields.notes: Not identified by any source; keep the original bytes.

fields.name: animationDelay
fields.notes: Animation delay. [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: animationTime
fields.notes: Animation time. [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: unknown2E
fields.notes: Not identified by any source; keep the original bytes.

fields.name: tileType
fields.notes: Tile state. [src: TK L1263-L1285]

fields.name: unknown31

roundTrip: Memory-only: records are rebuilt from the board file + section 12 whenever the license screen changes; nothing here is saved.
Edit in place while the board screen stays open; do not touch nameTextPointer/typeTextPointer unless pointing at valid game text.
column/row are single bytes: a board cannot exceed 256 columns or rows; the menu layout is a tighter practical limit.
Persist changes in the files (licd grid, battlepack section 12), never by writing these records anywhere.
gaps: Exact pointer path from [0x0209AC60] to the node record array, and the array length/ordering.
Bits of the flags folder at +0x14 and bytes 0x09-0x0A, 0x18-0x1F, 0x23-0x24, 0x26-0x29, 0x2E-0x2F, 0x31-0x33.
Width of identifier (+0x08) and animationTime (+0x2C) fields.
Element format of the license board array at [0x02EBF1A0].
License Node Icon record layout (only "2 groups x 4 entries" is known).
